scheduleHint: Monthly takes the same parts every month and pays for them.
competitorsHint: Each one adds its domain and backlink summary (about $0.05 each).
noCompetitors: Add competitors to the project to choose them here.
manualOnly: Snapshots are taken only when you take them.
costLine: One snapshot: {cost} · {paid} paid parts, {kept} free because the modules keep them fresh
costParts: {paid} paid parts are bought; {kept} are free because the modules keep them fresh. Rankings, audit, AI and Search Console data are always free.
noSource: The paid parts (traffic, keywords, backlinks) cannot be bought now: enter your own key or connect your OctopusOn SEO account under Sources. The free parts are kept anyway.
freePartsStill: The free parts are kept anyway.
takeWhat: The project as it stands today is kept: organic traffic and keywords, top pages, backlinks and referring domains, rank tracking, the site audit, AI visibility and Search Console. Two snapshots are compared later.
takeMonthlyHint: The same parts are taken and paid for every month; switch to By hand any time.
started: Taking the snapshot; it shows in the list when done.
emptyText: Keep where {domain} stands today. Take another a month later to see where the work began and where it is now side by side, and send your client a white-label before/after report.
oneMoreAuto: The starting point is kept. The comparison shows here after the next automatic snapshot; you can also take one now.
oneMoreManual: The starting point is kept. Take another snapshot to compare; you can also turn on monthly snapshots.
timelineHint: Newest first; the first one is the starting point.
deleteConfirm: Delete the snapshot "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
nothingHere: Nothing moved here between the two snapshots.
notKept: This part is not in both snapshots; it must be kept in both.
noRivals: To compare competitors, keep them in both snapshots.
keywordsNote: Keywords are compared among each snapshot's first 1,000 ranked keywords; lists are sorted by traffic impact.
aiGained: Answers that now name the brand
aiLost: Answers that no longer name the brand
